headline: Indian IT services posted solid top‑line growth, driven by AI‑related wins, but profit margins varied.
summary: Revenue rose across most majors, with TCS up 15% YoY and Coforge posting a 53.6% jump. AI revenue is becoming a material contributor, highlighted by HCLTech and Persistent. Margin expansion was mixed; TCS kept a 24% operating margin while Infosys trimmed FY guidance. Dividend payouts remained steady.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: AI‑led deals and revenue spikes were noted at TCS, HCLTech, Persistent and Wipro, supporting higher deal wins.

themes.title: Margin divergence
themes.detail: Operating margins stayed strong at TCS (24%) but fell at Infosys and Wipro, reflecting varied cost pressures.

themes.title: Dividend consistency
themes.detail: Most firms continued or raised interim dividends, signalling cash‑flow confidence.

leaders.why: Revenue surged 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and FY guidance was cut to 1‑2%.

Gaming was not highlighted in any report.
